name: @business-operations/run-client
description: Framework-free client for the ERP agent's run protocol: events channel, ordering, and AG-UI reduction.
//deps: Deliberately none, dev or otherwise. The frontend consumes this through a path alias, its vitest runs these tests, and Node 22 runs the TypeScript directly — so a build step, a bundler and a second test runner all stay unnecessary. Adding a dependency here means auditing it for the browser bundle too.
